notes:
Means something that is absolutely needed or indispensable. Almost always appears in the compound ⟦{必需品|ひつじゅひん}→必需品：15541_hitsujuhin⟧ (necessities, essential items), which is far more common than the standalone form.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{必需品|ひつじゅひん}→必需品：15541_hitsujuhin⟧: necessities, essential items
- ⟦{生活|せいかつ}→生活：01443_seikatsu⟧⟦{必需品|ひつじゅひん}→必需品：15541_hitsujuhin⟧: daily necessities
- {必需|ひつじゅ}⟦{物資|ぶっし}→物資：07863_busshi⟧: essential supplies

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧: necessity, need — far more common in everyday speech and broader in usage; {必需|ひつじゅ} is more formal and implies absolute indispensability
- ⟦{不可欠|ふかけつ}→不可欠：07027_fukaketsu⟧: indispensable — emphasizes that something cannot be left out
- ⟦{必須|ひっす}→必須：12516_hissu⟧: required, mandatory — often used for requirements, qualifications, or conditions
